q1_issues.issue: The involvement rule is asserted at TOP LEVEL, outside the non-factive `tell` seal, so the parse claims as fact that a set of people were involved in the son's death — the projection table lets only typing / Name / definitional-decomposition atoms out, and P's own distribution rule is explicitly required to sit inside the sealed (And ...).
(GroupOf sk_group_1 person) for the quantified "everyone" is likewise projected outside the seal, although "everyone" is a universal range, not a definite or named referent.

The rule inverts the restriction — it concludes involvement from group membership rather than using "involved in his son's death" as the restrictor — and carries no QuantifierPhrase companion for the explicit quantifier "everyone".
(Possession sk_death_1 terrance) — a genitive naming an event noun's underlying subject must take that subject role (die = change-of-state undergoer, so Patient), never Possession.

notes: Matrix routing is right: tell = Experiencer holder + Recipient addressee + sealed finite complement, with (Weekday monday) and Past. Sealing the "held responsible" small clause under Theme with no role on the matrix verb matches the impersonal-reported-attitude shape; the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel gets a Name but no type atom, arguably licensed by the kind word inside the name.
